shared_elements: carved head/face with rendered facial features
incised linear surface detail on a body
justification: Both depict the human form in relief and both include disc-like circular motifs and incised linear detail, but that is about as generic as anthropomorphic imagery gets. A shows a narrative procession of naturalistically proportioned profile figures leading an animal, framed by continuous rosette borders, while B is a single frontal, massively schematic bust-like figure whose surface bears isolated abstract carvings with no scene, border, or animals.
